# The nine cups: dark liners 0.26 m in radius and 0.3 m deep, open at the felt, facing inwards.
# Generated by make_course.py from course.py (do not edit).
new
material new Cup --base-color 0.2118 0.2078 0.3020 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Cup1 --vertices 12 --radius 0.26 --depth 0.3 --location -9.1000 10.0000 -0.0272
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
normals flip
mode object
